visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a bowl of ramen. A wooden spoon scoops up thick, frothy, creamy white broth. The bowl contains sliced chashu pork, two halves of a soft-boiled egg, green onions, and a sheet of nori. The background is a dark wooden restaurant table with warm, dim lighting. (2) A medium close-up shot shows the full bowl of ramen, with red chili powder sprinkled over one section. The camera remains static, emphasizing the rich texture of the ingredients and the frothy surface of the soup. (3) Chopsticks lift a thick bundle of yellow, wavy noodles from the broth. The noodles are glistening with soup and appear very elastic. The background shows a blurred interior of the restaurant. (4) A thin, pinkish slice of ham-like meat is lifted from the broth using chopsticks. The texture of the meat is clearly visible against the creamy beige background of the soup. (5) A high-angle shot captures two different bowls of ramen on the table. One is the creamy white broth, and the other is a darker broth with chopped green onions and small meat chunks. (6) A close-up shows a silver tray holding three glass bottles of condiments, including red pepper flakes and oils. (7) Golden oil is poured from a small silver pitcher onto the thick noodles in a white bowl, adding a glossy layer to the food. (8) A person wearing a white shirt and a protective paper bib pours a small bowl of white rice into the remaining ramen broth. They use chopsticks to mix the rice into the soup thoroughly. (9) The final shot is an exterior view of the restaurant '小麦の麺神' (Wheat Noodle God). A traditional white noren curtain with a crest hangs at the entrance. Several people are seen in the background waiting in line within a brightly lit shopping mall corridor.
